label: Smith 62 — demand and supply
description: A group and a role badge in the header, the profit and the participant's own values or costs under the order form, and the private state they read: a participant's group, side and induced-value schedule.

label: SSW — dividends earned, paid at the end
description: The usual trading panels, and under them the dividends a participant has earned so far, held back until the last period, and the private state they read: a participant's dividends, in cents.
